source.name: France Galop ticketing - Emirates Poules d'Essai
source.note: 'The Abu Dhabi Sports Council is the naming sponsor of the Emirates Poules d'Essai, a day on which two key races in the racing calendar are run: the Emirates Poule d'Essai des Poulains and the Emirates Poule d'Essai des Pouliches.' 2026 edition ran Sunday 10 May 2026 at ParisLongchamp. Also on france-galop.com/en/ours-partners (UAE President Cup Series).

note: Deal term not given on either France Galop page. The 'Emirates' in the race name is the Abu Dhabi Sports Council's UAE President Cup series branding, not the Dubai airline. Fee not published.
